a11y_required_displays_message: Changing screens or translating multiple screens at once requires the Accessibility permission. It lets PlayTranslate capture any display, not just the main one.
a11y_required_enhanced_message: PlayTranslate uses these enhanced controls to improve the auto-translate experience.
a11y_required_hotkey_message: Setting hotkeys requires the Accessibility permission. It lets PlayTranslate detect the keys you press while gaming.
a11y_stuck_message:
Accessibility is enabled for PlayTranslate, but Android has stopped the service and will not restart it on its own. Your device may report the app as malfunctioning in accessibility settings. This usually happens after the system force-stops the app to save battery.

To fix it, turn the service off and back on in your accessibility settings.
a11y_stuck_message_xiaomi: On Xiaomi devices, also enable Autostart for PlayTranslate and set Battery saver to No restrictions in the app's system settings. Without these, the system will keep stopping the service.
accessibility_dialog_message:
PlayTranslate needs the Accessibility permission to capture screenshots of the game screen on the top display while staying open on the bottom display.

PlayTranslate does not read any UI content, monitor input, or access any personal data — it only takes screenshots when you tap Translate or start live mode.

Go to Settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps → PlayTranslate → Enable.
accessibility_service_description: PlayTranslate uses the Accessibility Service to take screenshots of the game screen and show a floating overlay icon. No UI content, input events, or personal data are read or monitored.
accessibility_service_summary: For translating game text on screen
